anchors.paper_title: LFP and ECoG data during CopyDraw task with deep brain stimulation - Dareplane data for proof of concept paper
anchors.reason: The Radboud data record (10.34973/d214-m342) is the source deposit of this exact dataset: the same authors, CopyDraw task, and LFP/ECoG/EOG recordings from a Parkinson's patient.

metadata.methods_description: Neuro Omega recordings at 22 kHz of 16 STN LFP channels (Boston Scientific Vercise directional leads), 4 epidural ECoG contacts over left M1 and 4 EOG channels during the CopyDraw task. Conditions were DBS off, open-loop DBS on, and closed-loop adaptive DBS (day 4). ECoG was referenced to the left earlobe, DBS recordings to the left mastoid, with ground on the right mastoid. Events come from the Neuro Omega hardware port and stimulation marker channels.
